messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'I wish to inform you that all necessary modalities have been automatically concluded, and the fund has to be moved by HSBC office through LETTER TO CREDIT $10.5MILLION TO YOUR ACCOUNT.', 'We noticed that someone has made 3 suspicious attempts to log into your online account from this (IP) address 21.38.11.88 Therefore our security 'Recently, we notified you to guard against info bandits by migrating to the secure part of our banking system, but we did not receive any response from you.', 'WE HAVE NOW UNIFIED AND UPDATED OUR DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
